items.note: Opening line asks whether the July Pro price increase (49 to 69 USD) drove Pro churn.
Says to exclude every account with an @ourco.test email.
Defines churn as a non-empty cancel_month.
Says the output is for the CEO.
Asks for a summary of at most 5 bullets.
Asks for one suggested chart, saying what to plot without building it.
Asks how confident the conclusion is, given the small sample.

invented: 'today is October 2026': the person never gave the current date. The data only shows cancellations running through 2026-09, so the instruction to treat October as unobserved rests on a date the person didn't state.
'The CEO wants to know...': the person said the CEO is the audience, not that the CEO asked the question.
'Below is the complete data': the person never said the attached CSV is the full dataset.
